findings.fix: Replace the helper hypothesis with `∀ e : Σ b : Q, (b ⟶ i), FiniteDimensional k (M.obj e.1)` and give `dimVector_reflectRep_self_add` the corresponding source-local hypothesis; derive finite-dimensionality of `M.obj i` from surjectivity when needed. findings.issue: `finrank_forall_incoming` unnecessarily requires `∀ j, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj j)`; its domain only contains spaces indexed by incoming arrows. The same over-strong hypothesis propagates to `dimVector_reflectRep_self_add` at line 299.

summary: Two dimension lemmas assume finite-dimensionality at every vertex although only sources of arrows into the reflected vertex are relevant.
